g.text: Wrapping unsigned32 arithmetic · isolated iCE40 LUT4 resource proxy · consumed development study
x = in0; y = in1. Negative Δ reduces LUT4. Original and CSD heatmaps share a zero-based scale; paired Δ uses a symmetric scale.
All fixed pairs and losses shown. Full formulas, both arm counts and evidence hashes are in figure-data.json / figure-manifest.json.
